csv_project_name: Work Order A/E for Various Transportation and Highways
csv_scope_of_work: Design Engineering Services Various Contracts The consultant s work orders may include, but are not limited to the following: General studies Identification and preparation of grant applications for project funding and various project permitting (IDOT, MWRD, ACOE, CCFP, IEPA, IDNR, FEMA, USFW, etc.) Roadway segment / roadway corridor design Traffic signal design Geometric studies Traffic studies Intersection design and studies (inclusive of counts and capacity analyses) Complete Streets analysis and reviews Maintenance of traffic development, analysis and reports Detour route coordination including IDOT Detour Committee meetings GIS services Data collection and processing Topographic survey services; preparation of base maps Geotechnical investigations including Clean Construction Demolition Debris (CCDD) testing and analysis Land acquisition, including plats and legal descriptions, appraisals, review appraisals, negotiation services and document recording
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Cost Estimating, Feasibility Studies, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies

title: Work Order A/E for Various Transportation and Highways
short_description: Framework-style engineering services for various roadway and transportation projects in Cook County.
project_scope: On-call design engineering services for various transportation and highway-related contracts in Cook County. Potential tasks include general studies, grant application preparation, permitting, roadway segment and corridor design, traffic signal design, geometric studies, traffic studies, intersection design and capacity analyses, Complete Streets reviews, maintenance of traffic planning, detour coordination, GIS services, data collection, topographic surveys, geotechnical investigations including CCDD testing, land acquisition support, appraisals, negotiation services, and document recording. No specific bridge, span, building area, or defined individual project scope is stated.
services: A/E work order services covering civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, feasibility studies, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, stormwater, traffic design engineering, and traffic studies.
relevance_explanation:
- Broad on-call/framework-style transportation services without a defined structural project.
- Focus is mainly roadway, traffic, studies, permitting, surveying, and geotechnical tasks.
- No specific bridge, long-span structure, building, stadium, or special structure identified.
- Framework agreements without clear technical specification are generally low priority for sbp.
- Structural engineering is listed, but only as one discipline among many and without defined scope.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice describes multiple possible work orders for various transportation and highway tasks, but provides no defined project size, quantities, or construction scope from which a reliable estimate could be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. Up to four contracts may be awarded over a 60-month term, but no contract value, work order volume, or estimated engineering budget is provided.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, cost estimating, feasibility studies, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, stormwater, traffic design engineering, and traffic studies. No specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
